description: Use this when the user wants to find charts in their saved library. Returns paginated metadata and URLs, not chart documents; requires authentication. Draft-only editor charts have publishedAt null, hasDraft true, and sizeBytes 0 because sizeBytes measures only the stored published document, not draft storage.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page

limit.description: Page size; defaults to 100 and has a maximum of 1000

q.description: Case-insensitive title substring search; trimmed and limited to 100 characters

sort.description: Sort by creation time (default), update time, or title A-Z

source.description: Filter by one or more chart sources; omit to list all

name: list_charts

hasDraft.description: Whether an unpublished editor document exists; with sizeBytes 0 the chart is draft-only, otherwise it has unpublished edits alongside a stored published document

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 publish timestamp, or null when public URLs are dark

sizeBytes.description: Compressed size of the stored published document, excluding drafts; 0 means no published document has been stored yet

source.description: Chart origin; an open set of string values

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page

total.description: Exact match count, present for title searches or when explicitly requested

title: List charts
